name: claim_audit_grid
xsql:
SELECT a.claim_id                                              AS claim_id,
       a.action_name                                           AS action_name,
       Nvl(a.from_status, '')                                  AS prev_status,
       a.to_status                                             AS new_status,
       Nvl(a.action_by, '')                                    AS action_by,
       Nvl(FormatDateTime(a.action_date, 'dd MMM yyyy'), '')    AS action_date,
       Nvl(a.comments, '')                                     AS comments
FROM   claim.claim_audit a
WHERE  Nvl(:v_claim_id, '') <> ''
  AND  a.claim_id = :v_claim_id
ORDER BY a.action_date DESC, a.audit_id DESC
